source_facts_supplied_verbatim: C callers in kernel/syscall.c use struct mcs_rwlock_node_irqsave; baseline adapters cast the same type.
arch/x86_64/kernel/include/arch-lock.h defines SPINLOCK_IN_MCS_RWLOCK. Its selected IRQ-save node contains only unsigned long irqsave and is aligned64 with UBSAN disabled.

kernel/rust/lock_helpers.rs defines repr(C,align64) McsRwlockNodeIrqsave with CULong irqsave; process_helpers.rs also contains explicit size64/align64 assertions. Verify the assertions selected profile when reusing compiled evidence.

process_helpers::find_process returns a process with its hash-reader lock retained. It does NOT increment a process reference. The successful borrow is protected by that lock; a miss unlocks before null return.

Matching process_unlock must use the same live process/PID/hash/resource-set and exclusively owned live node, release the same lock and restore the saved IRQ state. Acquisition initializes irqsave; prior zero-initialization is not required.
The Rust adapters and genuine callees already exist. The prior process-bridge NO_GO explicitly did not establish that their bodies were held or absent.
